verifier_contract: Unchanged original Verifier, including real PackageManagerInternal.isPlatformSigned and original native cache result; original phase-1000 callback retained.
verification_failure_handling: Original boot-hook or verifier linkage/runtime errors are retained as unavailable state and converted to thrown unavailability, never a replacement Boolean verdict. Failed startup removes its worker and process-policy observer.
process_policy_scope: An authored temporary camera-owned OOM cap, not the full MIUI reclaim/performance policy. Camera close ends the sole cap; no post-close work model is inferred. Postprocessing completion can remove an explicit cap requested after close but does not release native handles or perform reclamation.
remaining_api_usage: Eighteen methods remain unported and throw UnsupportedOperationException with diagnostic counts; none of them has a known app call path.
prelaunch_history: Not synthesized from camera client events. The sampler supports genuine activity-launch callbacks but no producer has yet been integrated.
validation_boundaries: Host selector and artifact-ownership tests do not prove an Android build.
A present Binder service does not prove original verification or JNI initialization.
The host planner harness proves decision logic on synthetic tables, not kills or reclaim on the phone.
Capture, RAW, high-resolution, Ultra HDR, video and auxiliary ID evidence remain separate.

effective_predecessor_service_array.scope: Compiled resource. Runtime overlay state not queried.

ported_app_reachable_methods.reclaimMemoryForCamera: capture scene of the device reclaim table once per duration_reclaim_capture; kills through ProcessRecord.killLocked, reclaim through cgroup v2 memory.reclaim and CachedAppOptimizer compaction
ported_app_reachable_methods.boostCameraByThreshold: nonzero levels select the factory scene (video switch, 200 MP, live motion, Dolby) and run its kill_target actions; the zero level stays unported
ported_app_reachable_methods.notifyCameraPerformanceTime: retains the last 32 events for dumps; the watcher behind persist.miui.camera.perfwatcher.enable is unported and counted when requested
ported_app_reachable_methods.updateCloudData: bounded persist.vendor.camera.cloud property writes, JsonDisptcher.updateCloudData merge and callback redelivery; memory-reserve keys counted, not applied

reclaim_policy_deviations: adjustment floor at ProcessList.SERVICE_B_ADJ: the table low-memory escalation to adjustment 0 is suppressed and counted
at most 8 kills per batch and 16 compaction requests per pass
processes with foreground services, visible activities, the home or previous process, persistent and isolated processes are never candidates
factory lmkd commands, MIUI process list, PSI monitor scenes (kill_once), memory-reserve writes and the intercept-restart hook are not reproduced
memcg v1 memory.reclaim_once is absent on this cgroup v2 build; the root memory.reclaim file is written instead
configuration_source: factory JsonDisptcher.loadJson over the on-device encrypted tables, CameraReclaim section by callback; no decrypted table is shipped
